patterns.T7: Force on wires and moving charges

U1.name: Units I–II · Electrostatics + Current Electricity (16 marks)
U1.tip: Dipole: torque τ = pE sin θ. Capacitors: series 1/C = Σ1/Cᵢ, parallel C = ΣCᵢ, dielectric multiplies C by K, U = ½CV² (formula only). Field ⟂ equipotentials. Cells: V = E − Ir. Drift velocity v = eEτ/m. Balanced bridge P/Q = R/S.
U1.ncert: NCERT Physics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 1 Electric Charges and Fields, Ch 2 Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance, Ch 3 Current Electricity

U2.name: Units III–IV · Magnetism + EMI & AC (17 marks)
U2.tip: Loop axis B = μ₀IR²/2(R² + x²)^{3/2}. Galvanometer → voltmeter: series R = V/I_g − G; → ammeter: shunt. Like currents attract. Charge in B: r = mv/qB, T = 2πm/qB (speed-independent). Motional emf = Bvl. Series LCR: Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²), resonance X_L = X_C. Laminated cores cut eddy currents.
U2.ncert: NCERT Physics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 4 Moving Charges and Magnetism, Ch 5 Magnetism and Matter, Ch 6 Electromagnetic Induction, Ch 7 Alternating Current

U3.name: Units V–VI · EM Waves + Optics (18 marks)
U3.tip: Know the EM spectrum uses (UV sterilises, microwaves for radar). Lens 1/v − 1/u = 1/f with sign convention; lens maker 1/f = (μ − 1)(1/R₁ − 1/R₂); P = 1/f (m). TIR: denser → rarer and i > critical angle. YDSE β = λD/d; in a medium λ → λ/μ. Telescope (normal) m = f₀/f_e. Frequency never changes on refraction.
U3.ncert: NCERT Physics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 8 Electromagnetic Waves, Ch 9 Ray Optics and Optical Instruments, Ch 10 Wave Optics

U4.name: Units VII–VIII · Dual Nature + Atoms & Nuclei (12 marks)
U4.tip: hν = φ₀ + eV₀: intensity changes photocurrent, not stopping potential. λ = h/√(2meV) ≈ 1.227/√V nm for electrons. Bohr: rₙ ∝ n², Eₙ = −13.6/n² eV. Fission/fusion release energy because products have higher binding energy per nucleon.
U4.ncert: NCERT Physics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 11 Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter, Ch 12 Atoms, Ch 13 Nuclei

U5.name: Unit IX · Semiconductor Electronics (7 marks)
U5.tip: n-type = pentavalent dopant (P, As); p-type = trivalent (B, Al). Forward bias narrows the depletion layer. At equilibrium, diffusion and drift currents cancel. Full-wave rectifier output frequency = 2 × input. Transistors and logic gates are not in the 2026-27 list.
U5.ncert: NCERT Physics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 14 Semiconductor Electronics

questions.question: A charge is moved from one point to another on an equipotential surface. The work done by the electric field is:
questions.explanation: W = q(V_B − V_A) and V_B = V_A on an equipotential surface.

questions.question: A metal wire is connected across a fixed potential difference. If its length is doubled (same material and area), the drift velocity of electrons:
questions.explanation: v_d = eEτ/m and E = V/l. Doubling l halves E, so v_d halves.

questions.question: In a balanced Wheatstone bridge, P = 10 Ω, Q = 20 Ω and R = 15 Ω. Find S, in ohms.
questions.explanation: Balance: P/Q = R/S, so S = RQ/P = 15 × 20/10 = 30 Ω.
questions.remediation: Units I–II · Electrostatics + Current Electricity (16 marks): NCERT Physics Part I/II (Class 12, 2026-27): Ch 1 Electric Charges and Fields, Ch 2 Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance, Ch 3 Current Electricity; then the question types listed for this unit in the Blueprint PDF.

questions.question: A circular loop of radius R carries current I. Find the ratio of the magnetic field at its centre to the field on its axis at a distance √3R from the centre.
questions.explanation: B_centre = μ₀I/2R. B_axis = μ₀IR²/2(R² + 3R²)^{3/2} = μ₀I/16R. Ratio = 8.

questions.question: Why is the iron core of a transformer laminated?

questions.question: Photons of energy 5 eV fall on a metal of work function 2 eV. What is the stopping potential, in volts?
questions.explanation: eV₀ = hν − φ₀ = 5 − 2 = 3 eV, so V₀ = 3 V.

questions.question: Why does the fission of a heavy nucleus such as uranium-235 release energy?
questions.explanation: On the BE/A curve, middle-mass nuclei are more tightly bound than very heavy ones, so splitting releases the difference.
